A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the charge collective mode (CCM) of the charge ordered state (COS) is a Goldstone mode of the broken translational symmetry.

we have observed the Goldstone mode of the superconducting charge texture, and the observation is consistent with a two-component picture of HTS in the CuO2 plane.
